newsitem.title: USA: US Sen leader Lott undecided on Barshefsky waiver.
newsitem.headline: US Sen leader Lott undecided on Barshefsky waiver.

text.p: Senate Majority leader Trent Lott said Wednesday he was undecided on how he would vote on a waiver that Charlene Barshefsky needs to take the position of U.S. Trade Representative.
"I've still got to decide what I'm going to do on the actual waiver. I don't like waiving the law," he said to reporters outside a hearing.
Lott added that regardless of what his own decision would be, he would not actively block Barshefsky's nomination.
"I'm not interested in submarining this ... I'd like to see her be confirmed," he said.
